description: A toy kitchen set is in front, with a gray fridge on the left and an oven unit on the right, and a loaf-shaped piece of bread and a small green fruit on the floor. The right hand reaches to the fridge handle and pulls the door open, then reaches inside to grasp the bread and moves it out, setting it down on the floor to the right; next the right hand reaches back in to pick up the green fruit and brings it out toward the floor while the left hand stays resting nearby without touching anything, and the right hand then swings the fridge door closed.
